que_es: Temperature of the inside of the body, not of the skin.

como_se_mide_en_vuelo.estacion: Core temperature thermometer with the method stated, at rest and at least 30 minutes after exercise. Do not use skin temperature.
como_se_mide_en_vuelo.transito: Core temperature thermometer with the method stated, at rest and at least 30 minutes after exercise. Do not use skin temperature.
como_se_mide_en_vuelo.superficie: Core temperature thermometer with the method stated, at rest and at least 30 minutes after exercise. Do not use skin temperature.

por_que: A ground-based fever threshold gives false positives in flight: reduced gravity limits convection and evaporation.
referencia_en_vuelo: Resting core temperature rises by about 1 °C after 2.5 months on the ISS and can exceed 40 °C during exercise.
cuando_avisar: Extreme band of layer A (35.0 °C or less). 39.1 °C or more adds 2 points; 35.1 to 36.0 and 38.1 to 39.0 add 1 point only if it also departs from the profile baseline.
prevencion: Cabin thermal control (about 20-25 °C and 30-60% humidity), with more airflow in the exercise area to avoid heat pockets.
fuentes: Royal College of Physicians: NEWS2 scoring table
